title: runtime/endpoints
description: Endpoint registry file contract (feature 002, specs/002-model-endpoints; FR-001/FR-002, UR-MOD-011/012). Matches the live profiles/endpoints.yaml shape: a named list of nonsecret LLM endpoint entries shared by local servers (LM Studio, Ollama, vLLM, llama.cpp, Laya) and remote OpenAI-compatible APIs. Secrets are never inline: api_key_ref names an env var (env:NAME) or a config.local.yaml key (config:NAME) resolved at call time only. api is the adapter discriminator (openai-compat | systemone); systemone entries must declare decide_path (per-host route: /v1/systemone local, /api/alpha/decisions hosted). strict:true endpoints reject provider extension fields (extra_body, chat_template_kwargs) — clients must strip them (FR-011). schema_version is optional; absent means 0. YAML remains authoritative; UI writes this same file (SC-003).

schema_version.description: Contract revision; optional in v0 files (absent == 0). No maximum; strict consumers enforce their own ceiling per compatibility/VERSIONING.md.

endpoints.description: Named endpoint entries. ids must be unique (enforced by the registry layer; JSON Schema cannot express item-projection uniqueness).

id.description: Stable registry id (e.g. openrouter, local-laya). Referenced by bindings.yaml.

api.description: Wire-shape discriminator driving the client adapter. openai-compat: /v1 chat/embeddings/models. systemone: typed state+questions decisions via decide_path.

base_url.description: Endpoint base URL. openai-compat entries include the version suffix (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1); systemone entries are bare hosts (decide_path carries the route).

api_key_ref.description: Secret reference only, never the secret: env:NAME reads os.environ at call time; config:NAME reads a key (dotted path, top-level, or under llm.) in upstream/rimagent/config.local.yaml. null = open endpoint.

strict.description: When true the client MUST NOT send provider extension fields (extra_body, chat_template_kwargs, ...) — verified: Gemini's compat shim 400s on chat_template_kwargs (FR-011).

decide_path.description: systemone only: route for POST {state, questions} on base_url (e.g. /v1/systemone, /api/alpha/decisions).

models.description: Advertised/allowed model ids; probe re-verifies against the live list.

capabilities.description: Declared capabilities for role gating (FR-006): select needs typed_decisions|tool_calls, embed needs embeddings, plan/review need chat.

cost_hint.description: Optional free-form cost annotations (per-1k prices, tier notes). Advisory only.

notes.description: Operator notes (verification dates, quirks). Never secrets.
